bridge_depth_semantics: maximum intermediate prior-network bridge nodes per interval
opposing_bridge_policy: Q opposing-only excluded from active target/bridge pool; mixed genes retained

condition_functional_pool.rule: exclude gene only if baseline_contrast has response_opposing site(s) and no response_supporting site

cell_context_filter.policy: bridge-only; experimental anchors always protected; conservative_union keeps UNKNOWN; numeric proteomics values are positive evidence, missing values are UNKNOWN unless the source is explicitly binary/categorical

route_preservation_policy.temporal_effective_beam_width: reported per interval in pruning_summary and interval_summary
